Czech Extraliga (ELH) per-minute shot totals

Source: R/elh.R
elh_events.Rd

Cumulative shot attempts and shots on goal of one game, per team and game minute (visualization/events/{match_id}.json). shots (attempts) and shots_on_goal are running totals up to the end of the minute; team_score is the team's final score. The file's goal list and power plays are left out (return_parsed = FALSE keeps them; goals are in elh_pbp()). The body names no game id: it is the requested match_id. The file starts in 2017-18.

Usage

elh_events(match_id, return_parsed = TRUE)

Arguments

match_id

hokej.cz game id (the S3 file name; hokejcz_game_id of elh_game_ids() / elh_scoreboard()), e.g. 2928321. Not the onlajny game id.

return_parsed

Parse the payload into a tibble (default TRUE). Pass FALSE for the raw JSON as a list.

Value

A tibble (return_parsed = TRUE; home rows, then away, by minute; zero rows for a malformed body), else the raw JSON list:

col_nametypedescription
start_datecharacterScheduled start, local YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.
team_sidecharacterThe team's side: home or away.
team_namecharacterTeam full (official) name.
team_scoreintegerThe team's final goals.
minuteintegerGame minute (1-60), the end of which the totals run to.
shotsintegerCumulative shot attempts up to the end of the minute.
shots_on_goalintegerCumulative shots on goal up to the end of the minute.

Errors

fastRhockey_no_data: a missing file (404) or a file without minutes. fastRhockey_asset_fetch: an error envelope, an empty or non-JSON 200, or any other non-2xx. fastRhockey_bad_request: HTTP 400/422 or a bad match_id.

See also

Other ELH Functions: elh_game_ids(), elh_list_objects(), elh_pbp(), elh_pbp_goals(), elh_pbp_latest(), elh_pbp_mobile(), elh_scoreboard(), elh_shots()

  try(elh_events(match_id = 2928321))
